//: Everything except the device tasks runs natively. The PSP toolchain lives in WSL and scripts/psp.sh shells out to it.

tasks.label: configure
tasks.//: Nearly free once the cache exists.

tasks.label: build (pc app)
tasks.//: What F5 depends on: the application in a window.

tasks.label: build (psp)
tasks.//: The console release: build/dist/PSP/GAME/pocketfin (EBOOT.PBP and a jellyfin.txt to fill in) to copy to the root of the Memory Stick, and build/dist/pocketfin-<version>.zip, the same folder ready to publish. Needs the PSP toolchain in WSL, nothing else.
args: cd /root/jfpsp && export PATH=/usr/local/pspdev/bin:$PATH PSPDEV=/usr/local/pspdev && make BUILD_PRX=1 dist

tasks.label: checks
tasks.//: Build and run the portable suite. The one to reach for after any change to the portable layers.

tasks.label: checks (one group)
tasks.//: The same, filtered. No debugger, so it is the quick one while working on a single group.

tasks.label: device checks
tasks.//: Build, load and run the whole suite on the PSP -- the walks included -- then report. Refuses to start if the console is not answering.

tasks.label: device app
tasks.//: Loads the application on the console and leaves it running, so the screen can be watched over the cable.
